title: Evidence reference v0
description: How a claim cites one evidence item: which item, in what role, what the author says it shows (machine-checkable 'assert' preferred), and which code version / trace / action the author believes it belongs to.

shows.description: Short human-readable description written by the citing agent. Untrusted text: displayed, never executed.

assert.description: Predicates that must all hold on this evidence. Without them, support can only be 'unverified' or confirmed by an independent reviewer.

expect_binding.description: The citing author's belief about what this evidence is bound to. Validation fails if the record disagrees (e.g. a log from another code version).

locator.description: Narrow to part of the evidence. Lines for text kinds, JSON pointer for JSON kinds.
